words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.ex: The angle of the roof helps rain run off.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的角度有助于雨水流下。
words.en: An angle is the space between two lines or surfaces that meet, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The music touched his soul.
words.ex_cn: 这音乐触动了他的灵魂。
words.en: A person's soul is the spiritual part of them which some people believe continues existing after their body is dead.

words.tr:
n. 媒介；方法；
adj. 中等的；适中的；
words.ex: TV is a popular medium for advertising.
words.ex_cn: 电视是一种流行的广告媒介。
words.en: A medium is a method or way of expressing something.

words.ex: The class analyzed statistical data from the survey.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级分析了调查的统计数据。
words.en: Relating to the use of statistics or statistical methods.

words.ex: The glorious sunset lit up the whole sky.
words.ex_cn: 辉煌的日落染红了整个天空。
words.en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.ex: The ceiling is white and low.
words.ex_cn: 天花板是白色的，而且很低。
words.en: The ceiling is the upper interior surface of a room or other similar compartment.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.tr: n. 林薮；杂木林; n. （Shaw）人名；（中）邵（普通话·威妥玛）；（英、德）肖
words.ex: The shaw was full of tall trees and quiet birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片林薮长满了高大的树木和安静的鸟儿。
words.en: A shaw is a small wood or a clearing in a wood.

words.tr:
n. 基督教徒；
adj. 基督教的；
words.ex: He is a christian who goes to church every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名每周日都去教堂的基督教徒。
words.en: A Christian is a person who believes in Jesus Christ and follows his teachings.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上等公交车。
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: He read the previous chapter last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚读了前一章。
words.en: Existing or occurring before in time or order.

words.ex: He misleads his friends with false stories.
words.ex_cn: 他用虚假的故事误导他的朋友。
words.en: If you say that someone has misled you, you mean that they have made you believe something which is not true, either by telling you a lie or by giving you a wrong idea or impression.

words.tr: n. 代理人；特工；经纪人；（药）剂；动因；
words.ex: The real estate agent helped them buy a house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产代理人帮助他们买了一所房子。
words.en: An agent is a person who acts on behalf of another person or group.

words.tr: adj. 可怕的；极坏的；糟糕的；
words.ex: The storm caused a terrible flood.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴引发了一场可怕的洪水。
words.en: If something is terrible, it is very bad or of very poor quality.

words.ex: There are plentiful apples in the basket.
words.ex_cn: 篮子里有丰富的苹果。
words.en: If something is plentiful, there is a lot of it available.

words.ex: He reads the newspaper every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读报纸。
words.en: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.ex: The museum held an exhibition of ancient art.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆举办了一场古代艺术展览。
words.en: An exhibition is a public display of works of art or items of interest, often held in a museum or art gallery.

words.tr: phrase. 绿色的山谷；青翠的河谷
words.ex: The green valley was a perfect spot for our picnic.
words.ex_cn: n. 绿谷是我们野餐的完美地点。
words.en: A green valley refers to a valley that is lush with vegetation, often characterized by its vibrant green color and scenic beauty.

words.ex: The golden sun set behind the hills.
words.ex_cn: 金色的太阳在山后落下。
words.en: Something that is golden is bright yellow in color, like gold. It can also describe something that is very good or valuable.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.ex_cn: 他是个高个子男人。
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.ex_cn: 我们去动物园看狮子。
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.tr: v. 想；思考；“think”的过去式和过去分词； n. 思想；想法；
words.ex: I thought about the problem all day.
words.ex_cn: 我整天都在想这个问题。
words.en: An idea or opinion produced by thinking, or occurring suddenly in the mind.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: The dog wagged its tail happily.
words.ex_cn: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。
words.en: The tail of an animal, bird, or fish is the part extending beyond the end of its body.

words.ex: We took the ferry to cross the river.
words.ex_cn: 我们乘渡船过河。
words.en: A ferry is a boat that transports passengers and sometimes also vehicles, usually across rivers or short stretches of sea.

words.ex: The countries formed a peace league.
words.ex_cn: 这些国家组成了一个和平联盟。
words.en: A league is a group of people, countries, or organizations that have joined together for a particular purpose, or because they share a common interest.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我星期一有个会议。
words.en: Monday is the day of the week between Sunday and Tuesday.

words.tr:
adj. 第四的；
n. 第四个；
adv. 第四；
words.ex: He finished in fourth place.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了第四名。
words.en: The fourth item in a series is the one that you count as number four.

words.ex: He showed courage when he saved the child from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他从火中救出孩子时展现了勇气。
words.en: The ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.

words.ex: His silence implies he disagrees.
words.ex_cn: 他的沉默暗示他不同意。
words.en: To suggest or indicate something indirectly rather than stating it explicitly.

words.tr: phrase. 可以提取；可能吸引；可以绘制
words.ex: The exhibition may draw a lot of visitors.
words.ex_cn: 展览可能会吸引很多参观者。
words.en: To possibly create a picture or attract attention.

words.tr:
n. 曲调；调子；
v. 调整；调音；
words.ex: He hummed a happy tune while walking.
words.ex_cn: 他走路时哼着一首欢快的曲调。
words.en: A tune is a series of musical notes that are pleasant to listen to. It can also refer to adjusting something so that it works or looks better.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: The newspaper's headline said 'City Wins Championship'.
words.ex_cn: 报纸的大字标题写着‘城市赢得冠军’。
words.en: A headline is the title of a newspaper story, printed in large letters at the top of the story, especially on the front page.

words.ex: He plays the violin every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拉小提琴。
words.en: A violin is a musical instrument with four strings, played with a bow.

words.tr: n. （拉丁）法律；罗马公法（或私法）; n. （Lex）人名；（德、匈）莱克斯；（葡）莱什
words.ex: The lex Aquilia is a Roman law regarding damages for injury.
words.ex_cn: 《阿奎利亚法》是关于伤害赔偿的罗马法律。
words.en: The term 'lex' refers to the body of law or the study of law.

words.ex: The site of the old church is now a park.
words.ex_cn: 旧教堂的位置现在是一个公园。
words.en: A site is a piece of ground that is used for a particular purpose or where a particular thing happens.

words.ex: They established a new school in the village.
words.ex_cn: 他们在村里建立了一所新学校。
words.en: To set up or create something, such as an organization or a system, on a firm or permanent basis.

words.tr:
adj. 社会主义的
n. 社会主义者
words.ex: He is a socialist who believes in equal rights.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位相信平等权利的社会主义者。
words.en: A socialist is someone who believes in socialism, which is a political and economic theory advocating that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.tr:
pron. 几个；一些；
adj. 不同的；
words.ex: I have several books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我桌上放着几本书。
words.en: Several means a number of people or things that is more than a few but not a lot.

words.tr: phrase. 虎兵；比喻勇猛如虎的士兵
words.ex: The tiger soldier fought bravely in the battle.
words.ex_cn: 那位老虎兵在战斗中勇猛作战。
words.en: A term used to describe a soldier who is as brave and fierce as a tiger.

words.ex: The army tried to invade the neighboring country.
words.ex_cn: 军队试图侵犯邻国。
words.en: To enter a country, town, or region by force in order to take control of it.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.ex: The frequency of the radio station is 101.5 MHz.
words.ex_cn: 这个电台的频率是101.5兆赫。
words.en: The rate at which something happens or is repeated over a particular period of time.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.tr:
adj. 最初的；开始的；
n. 首字母；
words.ex: This is the initial plan for the project.
words.ex_cn: 这是这个项目的最初计划。
words.en: The first letter of a name or word, used to represent the whole name or word.

words.tr: phrase. 摇滚乐队经理；摇滚音乐人经纪人
words.ex: He worked as a rock manager for several famous bands.
words.ex_cn: 他曾担任几个著名乐队的摇滚乐队经理。
words.en: A person who manages or oversees a rock music band or its operations.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: v. 完成；实现；达到；获得；
words.ex: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以完成他的目标。
words.en: To achieve something means to reach a particular goal or result through effort, skill, or courage.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在星期六去公园。
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.tr: n. 缸；瓮；茶壶；咖啡壶；骨灰瓮；
words.ex: The flowers are in a large ceramic urn.
words.ex_cn: 花放在一个大的陶瓷缸里。
words.en: An urn is a container, especially one for holding the ashes of a cremated person.

words.ex: He wears a black overcoat in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件黑色大衣。
words.en: An overcoat is a long warm coat that you wear over your other clothes in cold weather.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: He will participate in the school play.
words.ex_cn: 他将参与学校的戏剧演出。
words.en: To take part in an activity or event.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: His anger grew when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到这个消息时，他的愤怒增加了。
words.en: A strong feeling of annoyance, displeasure, or hostility.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: He listens to music to relax.
words.ex_cn: 他听音乐来放松。
words.en: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

words.ex: There is a clear relation between exercise and health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼与健康之间有明显的关联。
words.en: A relation between two things is a connection or link between them.

words.ex: He threatened to call the police.
words.ex_cn: 他威胁要叫警察。
words.en: If someone threatens to do something unpleasant to you, or if they threaten you, they say or imply that they will do something unpleasant to you, especially if you do not do what they want.

words.ex: Her hard work led to success.
words.ex_cn: 她的努力带来了成功。
words.en: The achievement of something desired, planned, or attempted.

words.tr:
v. 隐藏；躲藏；
n. 兽皮；
words.ex: He hides the key under the mat.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙藏在垫子下面。
words.en: To conceal something or someone from view or discovery.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A king is a man who is the most important member of the royal family of his country, and who is considered to be the head of state of that country.

words.ex: He has a mental illness.
words.ex_cn: 他有心理疾病。
words.en: Relating to the mind or involving the process of thinking.

words.tr: phrase. 农场牌照；农场专用车牌
words.ex: The tractor has special farm plates to indicate it is used for agricultural purposes.
words.ex_cn: 这辆拖拉机有特殊的农用牌照，表明它是用于农业用途的。
words.en: Plates or dishes used for serving food in a farm setting, typically rustic or durable.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.ex: They want to educate their children well.
words.ex_cn: 他们想好好教育自己的孩子。
words.en: To educate someone means to teach them over a period of time at a school, college, or university.

words.ex: He lives independently and makes his own decisions.
words.ex_cn: 他独立生活，并自己做决定。
words.en: If one thing or person is independent of another, they are separate and not connected, so that the first one is not affected or influenced by the second.

words.tr:
adj. 日本的；日本人的；日语的；
n. 日语；日本人；
words.ex: She ate Japanese food for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她晚餐吃了日本菜。
words.en: Relating to Japan, its people, or their language.

words.ex: The river is broad and slow.
words.ex_cn: 这条河宽阔而平缓。
words.en: Something that is broad is wide.

words.ex: The children play in the sunshine.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阳光下玩耍。
words.en: Sunshine is the light and heat that comes from the sun.

words.tr: phrase. 贸易预付款；商业预支款项
words.ex: The trade advance between the two countries has been remarkable in recent years.
words.ex_cn: 近年来两国之间的贸易进展显著。
words.en: A trade advance is a payment made to a supplier or exporter before the goods are delivered, often used to finance the production or purchase of goods.

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.ex: She put cream on her coffee.
words.ex_cn: 她在咖啡里加了奶油。
words.en: Cream is the thick white or pale yellow fatty liquid which rises to the top when you boil milk, and which you can use in cooking or as a cosmetic.

words.ex: I understand the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 我理解这个数学问题。
words.en: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

words.tr: adj. 精致的；微妙的；易碎的；脆弱的；
words.ex: She wore a delicate lace dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精致的蕾丝连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is delicate is small and beautifully shaped. It can also be easily broken or damaged.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.ex_cn: 他下课后会离开房间。
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.ex: He found a weapon in the old box.
words.ex_cn: 他在旧箱子里发现了一件武器。
words.en: A weapon is an object that can be used to harm or kill someone, or to damage or destroy something.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.tr: phrase. 交流辅助工具；帮助有沟通障碍者进行交流的设备或方法
words.ex: A communication aid is essential for people with speech impairments.
words.ex_cn: 对于有语言障碍的人来说，通信辅助工具是必不可少的。
words.en: A device or piece of equipment designed to help people communicate, especially those who have difficulties with speech or hearing.

words.tr:
n. 声音；意见；
v. 表达；
words.ex: I heard a loud voice from the next room.
words.ex_cn: 我听到隔壁房间传来很大的声音。
words.en: Your voice is the sound that you make when you speak or sing.

words.tr: phrase. 支付界面；付款屏幕（指用于完成支付操作的电子显示屏或应用界面）
words.ex: The user is required to enter their payment details on the pay screen.
words.ex_cn: 用户需要在支付屏幕上输入他们的支付详情。
words.en: A pay screen is the interface where users enter their payment information to complete a transaction.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.tr: adj. 孤独的；寂寞的；偏僻的；
words.ex: He felt lonely after his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗去世后，他感到孤独。
words.en: If you are lonely, you are unhappy because you are alone or do not have anyone you can talk to.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.ex: The storm is a threat to the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对村庄构成了威胁。
words.en: A threat is a statement of an intention to inflict pain, injury, damage, or other hostile action on someone in retribution for something done or not done.

words.tr:
n. 傻瓜；蠢人；
v. 愚弄；
words.ex: He is a fool for spending all his money on games.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜，把所有钱都花在游戏上了。
words.en: A fool is someone who behaves in a silly way without thinking or someone who is tricked into believing or doing something that is not sensible.

words.tr: n. 区别；区分；优等评分；
words.ex: There is a clear distinction between right and wrong.
words.ex_cn: 对与错之间有明显的区别。
words.en: A distinction is a difference or contrast between similar things or people.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.ex: Playing games with friends is fun.
words.ex_cn: 和朋友一起玩游戏很有趣。
words.en: If you say that someone is fun or that they are fun to be with, you mean that you enjoy being with them because they make you feel happy and amused.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.ex: The mode of transportation is a bike.
words.ex_cn: 出行的方式是骑自行车。
words.en: A mode is a particular way or style in which something is done or experienced.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.tr:
v. 引用；报价；
n. 引用；引文；报价；
words.ex: He quoted Shakespeare in his speech.
words.ex_cn: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的话。
words.en: To repeat or copy out (a group of words from a text or speech), typically with an indication that one is not the original author or speaker.

words.tr:
n. 等价物；
adj. 相等的；等价的；
words.ex: The dollar is the equivalent of ten yuan.
words.ex_cn: 美元是十元的等价物。
words.en: If one amount or value is the equivalent of another, they are the same.

words.ex: It is evident that he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 很明显他很累。
words.en: If something is evident, it is easy to see, perceive, or understand.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: The foreigner asked for directions to the train station.
words.ex_cn: 这位外国人问了去火车站的路。
words.en: A foreigner is a person who comes from a country other than your own.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 猴子正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.tr:
v. （使）结冰；（使）冻结；
n. 严寒期；冻结；
words.ex: The water will freeze in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 水在寒冷的天气里会结冰。
words.en: If a liquid or a substance containing a liquid freezes, or if something freezes it, it becomes solid because of low temperatures.

words.ex: Good food and sleep help maintain health.
words.ex_cn: 良好的饮食和睡眠有助于保持健康。
words.en: The condition of a person's body or mind, especially in terms of the presence or absence of illnesses, injuries, or impairments.

words.tr: 短语动词。怂恿某人做某事（尤指淘气或冒险的事）；鼓动（某人）从楼上往下跳（俚语用法，通常用于挑衅或玩笑）
words.ex: The egg is downstairs on the kitchen table.
words.ex_cn: 鸡蛋在楼下的厨房桌子上。
words.en: To go downstairs, often in a sudden or unsteady manner, as if falling.

words.ex: My mother teaches me math every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上教我数学。
words.en: To impart knowledge or skill to someone through instruction or example.

words.ex: He looks at the stars through a telescope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过望远镜看星星。
words.en: A telescope is an optical instrument designed to make distant objects appear nearer, containing an arrangement of lenses, or of curved mirrors and lenses, by which rays of light are collected and focused and the resulting image magnified.

words.tr:
v. 无所事事；闲荡
adj. 懈怠的；闲散的；不做事的
words.ex: He idles away the whole afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 他整个下午都无所事事。
words.en: If you describe someone as idle, you mean they are not doing anything or they are not working hard.

words.ex: She has excellent night vision.
words.ex_cn: 她有很好的夜视能力。
words.en: Vision is the ability to see, the area that you can see, the ability to imagine how a country, society, industry, etc. could develop in the future and to plan in a suitable way, or an experience in which you see something that is not really there.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 德国的；
n. 德语；德国人；
words.ex: She speaks German music and eats German food.
words.ex_cn: 她听德国音乐，吃德国食物。
words.en: relating to Germany, its people, or their language

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.ex: We have lunch in the afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在下午吃午饭。
words.en: The part of the day from noon or lunchtime to evening.

words.tr:
adj. 资深的；高级的；年长的；
n. 年长者；大四学生；
words.ex: He is a senior engineer with 20 years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有20年经验的资深工程师。
words.en: Higher in rank, status, or importance; older in age.

words.ex: The car drove slowly through the fog.
words.ex_cn: 汽车缓缓驶过浓雾。
words.en: Fog is a thick cloud of tiny water droplets suspended in the atmosphere at or near the earth's surface which obscures or restricts visibility (to a greater extent than mist; strictly, reducing visibility to below 1 km).

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: He stared at the moon all night.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚凝视着月亮。
words.en: To look fixedly or intently at someone or something.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他很幸运赢得了奖品。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.tr:
adv. 然后；接下来；那时；
adj. 当时的；那时的；
words.ex: I ate breakfast, then I went to school.
words.ex_cn: 我吃了早餐，然后去了学校。
words.en: At that time; next in order of time; in that case.

words.ex: He put the letter in an envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把信装进了一个信封。
words.en: An envelope is a flat, usually rectangular or square, paper container for a letter, which you seal before you send it by post.

words.ex: The fisherman catches fish every morning.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫每天早上捕鱼。
words.en: A fisherman is a man who catches fish as a job or for sport.

words.ex: She enjoys simple life in the countryside.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢乡村里的简单生活。
words.en: Life is the existence of an individual human being or animal.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: He has short hair.
words.ex_cn: 他头发很短。
words.en: If something is short, it measures a small distance from one end to the other.

words.ex: The word 'happy' is an adjective.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'happy' 是一个形容词。
words.en: An adjective is a word that describes a noun or pronoun. In grammar, an adjective is a word whose main syntactic role is to modify a noun or pronoun, giving more information about the noun or pronoun's referent.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.tr:
v. 观看；观察；小心；
n. 手表；监视；注意；
words.ex: I watch TV every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我每天晚上看电视。
words.en: To look at or observe attentively over a period of time.

words.ex: The cable connects the computer to the printer.
words.ex_cn: 这条电缆将电脑连接到打印机。
words.en: A cable is a thick wire or rope, or a bundle of wires or ropes, used to carry electricity or electronic signals, or to support a structure.

words.tr:
n. 震惊；冲击；电击；震动；
v. 使震惊；使震动；
words.ex: The news of his death was a shock to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他去世的消息让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: A shock is a sudden, unexpected event or piece of news that causes a strong emotional reaction.

words.ex: He reads a science journal every week.
words.ex_cn: 他每周读一本科学期刊。
words.en: A journal is a newspaper or magazine that deals with a particular subject or professional activity.

words.ex: He bought a recent book about history.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一本最近出版的历史书。
words.en: Having happened, begun, or been done not long ago or not long before; belonging to a past period comparatively close to the present.

words.ex: The forest is dense with trees.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林树木茂密。
words.en: Something that is dense contains a lot of things or people in a small area.

words.tr:
n. 安逸；轻松；
v. 缓解；减轻；
words.ex: He enjoys the ease of living in a quiet village.
words.ex_cn: 他享受住在安静村庄里的安逸。
words.en: If you talk about the ease of a particular activity, you are referring to the way that it has been made easier to do, or to the fact that it is already easy to do. Ease is also a state of being comfortable and without worry or anxiety.

words.ex: The teacher will assign homework today.
words.ex_cn: 老师今天会布置作业。
words.en: To give someone a particular job or task; to allocate a resource or responsibility to a particular person or purpose.

words.ex: You won't pass the test unless you study.
words.ex_cn: 除非你学习，否则你不会通过考试。
words.en: You use unless to introduce the only circumstances in which an event you are mentioning will not take place or in which a statement you are making is not true.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.tr: adv. 更远地；“far”的比较级； adj. 更远的；“far”的比较级；
words.ex: He ran farther than his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得比他弟弟更远。
words.en: At or to a greater distance or more advanced point.

words.ex: The toilet is broken and needs repair.
words.ex_cn: 马桶坏了，需要修理。
words.en: A toilet is a large bowl connected to the plumbing and used for urinating and defecating, typically fitted with a seat and flushing device.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.tr:
v. 击；撞；
n. 撞击；敲击；
words.ex: He knock on the door.
words.ex_cn: 他敲了敲门。
words.en: To strike a surface noisily to attract attention, especially when waiting to be let in through a door.

words.ex: The new teacher transformed the class into a lively group.
words.ex_cn: 这位新老师把班级变成了一个充满活力的团体。
words.en: To transform something or someone means to change them completely and usually improve their appearance, form, or structure.

words.tr:
v. 需要；
n. 需要；
words.ex: I need help with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 我需要帮助做作业。
words.en: If you need something, you must have it because it is essential.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.tr: phrase. 费用申请；指提交申请以请求支付某项服务或项目的费用
words.ex: Please submit your fee application along with the required documents.
words.ex_cn: 请随所需文件一起提交您的费用申请。
words.en: A formal request for payment or reimbursement of fees.

words.ex: This car is economical because it uses little fuel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车很经济，因为它耗油少。
words.en: Using money, resources, or time in a careful and effective way.

words.ex: He was born in November.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在十一月。
words.en: November is the eleventh month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.ex: He begs for food on the street.
words.ex_cn: 他在街上乞讨食物。
words.en: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.ex: The math teacher asked for a proof of the theorem.
words.ex_cn: 数学老师要求给出这个定理的证明。
words.en: Proof is a fact, argument, or piece of evidence which shows that something is definitely true or definitely exists.

words.tr:
adj. 巨大的；伟大的；
n. 巨人；伟人；
words.ex: The giant elephant stood near the tree.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的大象站在树旁。
words.en: A giant is an imaginary person who is very big and strong, especially one mentioned in old stories. In everyday language, a giant can also refer to a very large and successful company or organization.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: He swims every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上游泳。
words.en: To swim means to move through water by moving your arms and legs, without touching the bottom.

words.ex: The bridge is made of iron.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥是用铁建造的。
words.en: Iron is a strong hard metal that is used to make steel and is also found in small quantities in blood and food.

words.ex: He is having a birthday party tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要开生日派对。
words.en: Your birthday is the anniversary of the date on which you were born.

words.ex: He is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名老师。
words.en: Used to indicate the identity, qualities, or condition of someone or something.

words.ex: The cat jumped onto the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳到了桌子上。
words.en: If something moves or is put onto an object or surface, it is then on that object or surface.

words.ex: The car exceeded the speed limit.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车超过了限速。
words.en: To be greater in quantity, degree, or intensity than something else.

words.tr:
n. 结果；
v. 导致；
words.ex: The result of the test was good.
words.ex_cn: 这次测试的结果很好。
words.en: A consequence, outcome, or effect of an action or situation.

words.ex: He speaks English with a French accent.
words.ex_cn: 他说英语时带有法国口音。
words.en: An accent is a distinctive way of pronouncing a language, especially one associated with a particular country, area, or social class.

words.ex: There is a big statue in the city center.
words.ex_cn: 城市中心有一座巨大的雕像。
words.en: A statue is a large sculpture of a person or an animal, made of stone or metal.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.tr:
adj. 糟糕的；可怕的；
adv. 非常；极其；
words.ex: The weather today is awful.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you say that something is awful, you mean that it is extremely unpleasant, shocking, or bad.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.tr:
v. 移动；搬家；
n. 行动；移动；
words.ex: Please move the chair.
words.ex_cn: 请移动椅子。
words.en: To change position or to cause something or someone to change position, especially in a particular direction or to a particular place.

words.tr:
v. 站立；忍受；
n. 立足点；
words.ex: The boy stands near the door.
words.ex_cn: 男孩站在门附近。
words.en: If you stand somewhere, you are in an upright position with your feet on the ground. If something stands somewhere, it is in an upright position in that place.

words.ex: He drives an automobile to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天开车去上班。
words.en: A vehicle that is powered by an engine and is used for carrying passengers on roads.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.tr:
v. 中断；暂停；
n. 停顿下来；
words.ex: The storm halted the flight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴中断了航班。
words.en: to bring or come to a stop; a temporary or permanent stop

words.tr: n. 会议；会面； v. 遇见；见面；“meet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting starts at 9 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 会议上午九点开始。
words.en: A meeting is an event in which a group of people come together to discuss things or make decisions.

words.ex: Someone left their bag on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 有人把包落在椅子上了。
words.en: You use someone to refer to a person without saying exactly who you mean.

words.tr: n. 街坊；四邻；街道；附近地区；
words.ex: I walk my dog in the neighborhood every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上在街坊遛狗。
words.en: A neighborhood is one of the parts of a town where people live.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.ex: He loves geography and learns about countries and rivers.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢地理学，学习各国和河流的知识。
words.en: The study of the physical features of the earth and its atmosphere, and of human activity as it affects and is affected by these, including the distribution of populations and resources, land use, and industries.

words.tr: phrase. 原始发动机；未经调校的发动机
words.ex: The raw engine needs to be refined before it can be used in a vehicle.
words.ex_cn: 这个原始引擎在使用于车辆之前需要进行精炼。
words.en: An engine that is unrefined or in its basic, unprocessed state.

words.tr:
adj. 早的；早前的；
adv. 提早地；
words.ex: He woke up early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上起得很早。
words.en: Before the usual or expected time; at or near the beginning of a particular period or series of events.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在野外大声吼叫。
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.ex: Please attach the file to the email.
words.ex_cn: 请将文件附加到邮件中。
words.en: To attach something to something else means to fasten or join it to the other thing.

words.tr: phrase. 一旦欺骗；曾经欺骗
words.ex: He once deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他曾经用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: To deceive someone at a specific time or on a particular occasion.

words.tr: phrase. 婚嫁之舞（某些文化中庆祝婚礼的传统舞蹈）
words.ex: They will marry dance at the wedding party.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在婚礼派对上跳结婚舞。
words.en: A dance performed at or associated with a wedding ceremony.

words.ex: Every citizen must follow the law.
words.ex_cn: 每个公民都必须遵守法律。
words.en: A citizen is a person who is legally recognized as a member of a country or state, either by birth or by naturalization, and who is entitled to its protection and privileges.

words.tr: n. 主席；主持人；董事长；
words.ex: The chairman called the meeting to order.
words.ex_cn: 主席宣布会议开始。
words.en: A chairman is a man who is in charge of a meeting, committee, or organization.

words.ex: The children played on the green hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在绿色的丘陵上玩耍。
words.en: A hill is a piece of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it, but not as high as a mountain.

words.tr:
adj. 每周的；
adv. 每周；
words.ex: He gets paid weekly.
words.ex_cn: 他每周领工资。
words.en: Happening or done once a week or every week; a newspaper or magazine that is published once a week.

words.ex: He looks at the bug through a microscope.
words.ex_cn: 他通过显微镜观察这只虫子。
words.en: An instrument used for viewing objects that are too small to be seen by the naked eye, especially one that uses a combination of lenses to produce a magnified image.

words.ex: He passed the test by studying hard.
words.ex_cn: 他通过努力学习通过了考试。
words.en: If something is done by a person or thing, that person or thing does it.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；
v. 分阶段进行；
words.ex: The project is in its final phase.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目正处于最后阶段。
words.en: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

words.ex: He washes his hands with soap.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥皂洗手。
words.en: A substance used with water for washing and cleaning, made of a compound of natural oils or fats with sodium hydroxide or another strong alkali, and typically also perfume and coloring.

words.tr: adj. 温和的；文雅的；温柔的；
words.ex: The mother gave a gentle hug to her child.
words.ex_cn: 母亲给了孩子一个温和的拥抱。
words.en: Someone who is gentle is kind and calm, and does not behave in a violent or harsh way.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: The dog follows its owner every day.
words.ex_cn: 狗每天跟随它的主人。
words.en: To go or come after (a person or thing proceeding ahead); move or travel behind.

words.tr:
n. 缺乏；短缺；
v. 缺乏；短缺；
words.ex: There is a lack of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄缺乏干净的水。
words.en: If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it or it does not exist at all.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: He solved the crossword puzzle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解开了这个填字谜。
words.en: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

words.ex: He concluded that the experiment failed.
words.ex_cn: 他得出结论说实验失败了。
words.en: If you conclude that something is true, you decide that it is true using the facts you know as a basis.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: Her kindness helped me when I was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当我不开心时，她的善意帮助了我。
words.en: Kindness is the quality of being gentle, caring, and helpful.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.ex: He believes in socialism and wants equal rights for all.
words.ex_cn: 他相信社会主义，希望所有人都享有平等的权利。
words.en: Socialism is a political and economic theory of social organization which advocates that the means of production, distribution, and exchange should be owned or regulated by the community as a whole.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.ex: His judgment was clear and fair.
words.ex_cn: 他的判断清晰而公正。
words.en: A judgment is an opinion that you have or express after thinking carefully about something.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: He reads the bible every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上读《圣经》。
words.en: The Bible is the holy book of Christianity, consisting of the Old Testament and the New Testament.

words.ex: The empire ruled many countries long ago.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国很久以前统治了许多国家。
words.en: An empire is a group of countries or territories that are under the control of a single ruler or government.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.tr:
v. 估算；估价；
n. 估价；估算；
words.ex: Can you estimate how long it will take?
words.ex_cn: 你能估算一下需要多长时间吗？
words.en: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

words.ex: The rain ceased after an hour.
words.ex_cn: 一小时后，雨停了。
words.en: If something ceases, it stops happening or existing.

words.tr: phrase. 行动要点；需采取行动的事项
words.ex: We need to write down the action point after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要在会议后写下行动要点。
words.en: A specific point or item that requires action or attention as part of a plan or process.

words.tr: phrase. 社交聚餐；指为增进人际关系而与他人共进的餐食
words.ex: We often have social meals after work to strengthen our team bonds.
words.ex_cn: 我们经常在工作后进行社交聚餐，以加强团队联系。
words.en: A shared meal that fosters social interaction and community bonding.

words.ex: My mother cooks dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A mother is a female parent of a child. Mothers are women who inhabit or perform the role of bearing some relation to their children, who may or may not be their biological offspring.

words.ex: He hammered the nail into the wood.
words.ex_cn: 他把钉子敲进了木头里。
words.en: A nail is a thin pointed piece of metal that is hammered into materials as a fastener. It can also refer to the hard covering at the end of fingers and toes. As a verb, to nail means to fasten something with a nail or to catch or accomplish something successfully.

words.tr:
v. 原谅；宽恕；请再说一遍
n. 原谅；宽恕
words.ex: Can you pardon me for being late?
words.ex_cn: 你能原谅我迟到吗？
words.en: If you pardon someone, you forgive them for something they have done wrong. If someone is pardoned, they are officially forgiven for a crime they have committed.

words.ex: He has a big nose.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个大鼻子。
words.en: The part of the face or head that contains the nostrils and organs of smell and through which a person or animal breathes.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: In the sentence 'She runs', 'runs' is a verb.
words.ex_cn: 在句子 'She runs' 中，'runs' 是一个动词。
words.en: A word that is used to describe an action, state, or occurrence, and forming the main part of the predicate of a sentence, such as 'run', 'become', or 'happen'.

words.tr: n. 影响；作用；效果；效应；
words.ex: The new law had a big effect on traffic.
words.ex_cn: 新法律对交通产生了很大影响。
words.en: A change that is a result or consequence of an action or other cause.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抓住球。
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: He put the milk in the fridge.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶放进冰箱里。
words.en: A fridge is a large container which is kept cool inside, usually by electricity, so that the food and drink in it stays fresh.

words.ex: It was raining; nevertheless, we went for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨了；尽管如此，我们还是去散步了。
words.en: Despite what has just been said or done; nonetheless.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: He stayed awake all night to finish his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他整晚醒着完成作业。
words.en: If you are awake, you are not sleeping. If you awake, you wake up.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都说你好。
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.tr: phrase. 培养率；文化增长率（常用于微生物培养或社会文化发展语境中）
words.ex: The culture rate of the bacteria was significantly higher in the new medium.
words.ex_cn: 细菌在新培养基中的培养率显著提高。
words.en: The speed or frequency at which cultural practices, ideas, or innovations spread within a society.

words.tr:
n. 地点；场所；斑点；
v. 发现；识别；
words.ex: This is the spot where we met for the first time.
words.ex_cn: 这是我们第一次见面的地方。
words.en: A spot is a particular place or point. It can also refer to a small mark or stain, or a small amount of something. As a verb, it means to see, notice, or recognize someone or something.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: He bought a cigarette at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一支香烟。
words.en: A cigarette is a small roll of finely cut tobacco for smoking, enclosed in a wrapper of thin paper.

words.tr: n. 第二；第二名；第二人
words.ex: He came in 2nd in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Coming after the first in order, position, time, or importance.

words.tr: phrase. 熊的工坊；常指制作或展示泰迪熊等毛绒玩具的手工工作室
words.ex: The Bears Workshop is known for its high-quality handmade teddy bears.
words.ex_cn: Bears Workshop以其高质量的手工泰迪熊而闻名。
words.en: A collaborative space or event where individuals work together on creative or practical projects, often involving bears as a theme or metaphor.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.tr:
adj. 完整的；完成的；
v. 完成；
words.ex: The book is complete with all chapters.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有所有章节，是完整的。
words.en: If you complete something, you finish doing, making, or producing it.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.tr:
adj. 男性的；雄性的；
n. 男性；雄性；
words.ex: The male bird has bright red feathers.
words.ex_cn: 这只雄鸟有鲜艳的红色羽毛。
words.en: A male is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that cannot have babies. In humans, males are usually considered to be boys or men.

words.ex: He needs additional time to finish the homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要额外的时间来完成作业。
words.en: If something is additional, it is extra and is added to what is already there.

words.ex: He works in a medical center.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家医疗中心工作。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of medicine.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.ex_cn: 她每天早上扫地。
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.ex: He cooks soup on the stove.
words.ex_cn: 他用炉子煮汤。
words.en: A stove is a piece of equipment which provides heat, either for cooking or for heating a room.

words.ex: He is a friendly boy who smiles at everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个友好的男孩，对每个人都微笑。
words.en: If someone is friendly, they behave in a pleasant, kind way, and like to be with other people.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于动物的。
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The prince rode a white horse through the castle gate.
words.ex_cn: 王子骑着一匹白马穿过城堡的大门。
words.en: A prince is a male member of a royal family, especially the son of a king or queen.

words.tr: adj. 有价值的；贵重的；值钱的；
words.ex: This old book is valuable to historians.
words.ex_cn: 这本旧书对历史学家来说很有价值。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

words.tr:
n. 脂肪；
adj. 肥的；
words.ex: This food has too much fat.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物含有太多脂肪。
words.en: Fat is a substance contained in foods such as meat, cheese, and butter, which is used by the body to produce energy or stored in the body as a layer.

words.tr: adj. 充满生机的；活泼的；
words.ex: The market is lively with people and music.
words.ex_cn: 市场里人来人往，音乐欢快，充满生机。
words.en: If you describe someone as lively, you mean they are full of life, energy, or enthusiasm.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.tr: v. 射击；拍摄（电影）；疾驰；“shoot”的过去式和过去分词； n. 照片；射击；射门；
words.ex: He shot the target with his gun.
words.ex_cn: 他用枪射击了目标。
words.en: A shot is an act of shooting a gun, or the sound that this makes. It can also refer to an attempt to do something, a photograph, or an injection.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.tr:
v. 悬挂；吊；
n. 悬挂；
words.ex: He hangs a picture on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 他把一幅画挂在墙上。
words.en: To hang something means to attach it to something else so that it is supported from above and does not touch the ground.

words.ex: He speaks a local dialect in his village.
words.ex_cn: 他在村子里说一种地方方言。
words.en: A dialect is a form of a language that is spoken in a particular area and that uses some of its own words, grammar, and pronunciations.

words.tr:
n. 风；
v. 缠绕；蜿蜒；
words.ex: The wind blew strongly through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风猛烈地吹过树木。
words.en: Wind is the natural movement of air, especially in the form of a current of air blowing from a particular direction.

words.tr:
n. 野餐；
v. 去野餐；
words.ex: We had a picnic in the park on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周日去公园野餐了。
words.en: A picnic is a meal eaten outdoors, especially in the countryside, usually as part of a trip or outing.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.ex: A hammer is a useful instrument for building.
words.ex_cn: 锤子是建造时有用的工具。
words.en: An instrument is a tool or device used for a particular task, especially for scientific, medical, or technical work. It can also refer to a musical instrument.

words.tr: phrase. 最佳锻炼；顶级运动项目
words.ex: This top exercise is designed for advanced learners.
words.ex_cn: 这项顶级练习是为高级学习者设计的。
words.en: The most effective or recommended physical activity for achieving fitness or health goals.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr: phrase. 片状地层；片状接地（地质或工程术语，指呈片状分布的地层或接地形式）
words.ex: The sheet ground is covered with a thin layer of ice.
words.ex_cn: 薄层地面上覆盖着一层薄冰。
words.en: A thin layer of ground, often referring to a surface covered with a thin layer of ice or snow.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.ex_cn: 球停在了场地的中间。
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.ex: The stars are visible at night.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚可以看到星星。
words.en: If something is visible, it can be seen.

words.tr: prep. 关于； v. “concern”的现在分词；
words.ex: The book is concerning climate change.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于气候变化的。
words.en: If something is concerning, it causes you to feel concerned about it.

words.tr: v. 离开；“leave”的过去式和过去分词； n. 左；左边； adj. 左边的； adv. 向左；在左边；
words.ex: He left the house early this morning.
words.ex_cn: 他今天早上早早离开了家。
words.en: If there is a certain amount of something left, or if you have a certain amount of it left, it remains when the rest has gone or been used.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.tr: phrase. 但是；然而 n. 推销员
words.ex: He is a salesman, but he lives 13 miles apart from his office.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名销售员，但他住在离办公室13英里远的地方。
words.en: A salesman who is 13 units (e.g., years, items) apart in experience, performance, or ranking from others.

words.ex: Her story inspires me to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 她的故事激励我更加努力。
words.en: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: The heavy workload became a burden for her.
words.ex_cn: 繁重的工作量成了她的负担。
words.en: A burden is a heavy load that is difficult to carry, or a duty or responsibility that is hard to bear.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: He bought fresh vegetables from the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他从本地市场买了新鲜蔬菜。
words.en: Something that is local relates to a particular area or to the area where you live.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.ex_cn: 太阳从东方升起。
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.ex: I have two apples.
words.ex_cn: 我有两个苹果。
words.en: The number equivalent to the sum of one and one; one less than three.

words.ex: How do you make coffee?
words.ex_cn: 你如何煮咖啡？
words.en: In what way or manner; by what means.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: He wants to pursue his dream of becoming a writer.
words.ex_cn: 他想追求成为作家的梦想。
words.en: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.

words.tr:
adj. 全部的；整体的；
n. 整个；全部；
words.ex: He ate the whole cake by himself.
words.ex_cn: 他一个人吃掉了整个蛋糕。
words.en: The whole of something is all of it.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.tr:
n. 未来；将来；前途；
adj. 将来的；未来的；
words.ex: We cannot predict the future.
words.ex_cn: 我们无法预测未来。
words.en: The future is the time after the present, or the events that will happen then.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: He obtained a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周获得了一份新工作。
words.en: If you obtain something, you get it or achieve it.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.ex: The book has a thick cover.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有厚厚的封面。
words.en: Having a large distance between the top and bottom or front and back surfaces; not thin.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.tr: phrase. 雨生草（雨季迅速发芽生长的草类，多见于干旱或半干旱地区）
words.ex: The rain grass grows abundantly after the rainy season.
words.ex_cn: n. 雨草在雨季过后生长得十分茂盛。
words.en: Rain grass refers to a type of plant that thrives in rainy conditions, often used for soil erosion control and landscaping.

words.tr: phrase. 重要职责；重大责任
words.ex: Fulfilling the important duty of protecting national security is the primary mission of the military.
words.ex_cn: 履行保护国家安全的重要职责是军队的首要任务。
words.en: An important duty refers to a significant responsibility or obligation that one is required to fulfill.

words.ex: The size of the box is too big for the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的大小对架子来说太大了。
words.en: The physical dimensions, proportions, magnitude, or extent of an object.

words.tr:
n. 返回；归还；
v. 返回；归还；
words.ex: The return of the train was delayed.
words.ex_cn: 火车的返回被推迟了。
words.en: To go or come back to a place or person. To give, send, or put something back to its original place or condition.

words.ex: The children played on the slope behind the house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在房子后面的斜坡上玩耍。
words.en: A slope is a surface that is at an angle, so that one end is higher than the other.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.tr: phrase. 卫星链；指由多个卫星组成的通信或数据传输链条系统
words.ex: The company plans to launch a satellite chain to provide global internet coverage.
words.ex_cn: 该公司计划发射一组卫星链，以提供全球互联网覆盖。
words.en: A series of satellites linked together to provide coverage over a wide area, often used for communication or data transmission.

words.tr:
v. 传播；扩散；散布；
n. 传播；蔓延；范围；
words.ex: The virus spread quickly through the city.
words.ex_cn: 病毒在城市中迅速传播。
words.en: To spread something means to open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

words.tr:
n. 螺丝钉；
v. 拧紧；
words.ex: He tightened the screw with a screwdriver.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了螺丝钉。
words.en: A screw is a metal object similar to a nail, with a raised spiral line around it. Screws are used to fasten things together.

words.tr:
n. 供应；供给；
v. 供给；
words.ex: The city needs a steady supply of water.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市需要稳定的供水。
words.en: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

words.tr:
n. 病人；
adj. 有耐心的；
words.ex: The doctor helped the patient feel better.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助病人感觉好些了。
words.en: A patient person is able to wait for a long time or deal with a difficult situation without becoming angry or upset.

words.tr: phrase. 拉伸压力机；用于金属成型的拉深压力机
words.ex: The drawing press is used to shape metal sheets into specific forms.
words.ex_cn: 拉拔式压床用于将金属板材加工成特定形状。
words.en: A machine used in manufacturing to shape metal sheets by applying pressure.

words.ex: He dare not speak up in class.
words.ex_cn: 他不敢在课堂上发言。
words.en: If you dare to do something, you are brave enough to do it, even though it may be dangerous or shocking or may cause trouble for you.

words.tr:
conj. 两者之一；
adv. 也（用于否定词组后）；
pron. 两者中的任何一个；（用于否定句）两者都不；
words.ex: You can have either tea or coffee.
words.ex_cn: 你可以喝茶或者咖啡，二选一。
words.en: Used before the first of two (or occasionally more) alternatives that are being specified (the other being introduced by ‘or’).

words.ex: He sits on the bench every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上坐在长椅上。
words.en: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.tr:
v. 侮辱；辱骂
n. 侮辱；辱骂
words.ex: He insulted her with rude words.
words.ex_cn: 他用粗鲁的话侮辱了她。
words.en: To insult someone means to say or do something that is rude or offensive.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.tr: adj. 糟糕的；坏的；严重的；
words.ex: The weather today is bad.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很糟糕。
words.en: If you describe something as bad, you mean that it is of a low or unacceptable standard or quality.

words.tr:
n. 全体演员；
v. 投掷；扔；投射；
words.ex: The cast of the play performed very well.
words.ex_cn: 这部剧的全体演员表演得非常好。
words.en: To cast something means to throw it forcefully in a particular direction.

words.tr:
adj. 化学的；
n. 化学品；
words.ex: The lab has a chemical reaction.
words.ex_cn: 实验室里有一个化学反应。
words.en: A chemical is a substance that is used in or produced by a process involving chemistry.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: He passed the exam with high marks.
words.ex_cn: 他以高分通过了考试。
words.en: An exam is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.

words.tr: v. “be”的现在分词；是；在； n. 存在；生物；人；生命；
words.ex: He is being quiet in the library.
words.ex_cn: 他正在图书馆里保持安静。
words.en: The state or quality of having existence.

words.ex: He made a big effort to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他努力完成这个项目，按时交工。
words.en: If you make an effort to do something, you try hard to do it.

words.ex: The technician installed an outswitch to control the external device.
words.ex_cn: 技术人员安装了一个外开关来控制外部设备。
words.en: To disconnect or switch off an electrical or electronic device, often used in computing or telecommunications.

words.ex: The ship arrived at the port at noon.
words.ex_cn: 船在中午到达了港口。
words.en: A port is a place where ships load and unload goods or passengers.

words.tr:
n. 奖赏；奖品；奖金；
v. 珍视；
words.ex: He won a prize for the best science project.
words.ex_cn: 他因最好的科学项目获得了奖赏。
words.en: A prize is something valuable, such as money or a trophy, that is given to someone who wins a competition or who has done outstanding work.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我知道他明天会来。
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.ex: I remember my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我记得我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

words.tr:
num. 一百万；
n. 百万；百万个；
words.ex: There are a million stars in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 天空中有百万颗星星。
words.en: A million is the number 1,000,000.

words.tr: n. 满；完全；十分；丰满；发胀
words.ex: The fullness of the orchestra's sound was breathtaking.
words.ex_cn: 管弦乐队的声音之丰富令人叹为观止。
words.en: The state of being full or complete.
